lessons_learned.root_cause: A JWT token used for acceptance testing was stored in a plaintext file (frontend/ba_quiz_token.txt) and accidentally committed along with legitimate changes via broad git add .
preventive_measures: Secret scan script (scripts/security/scan-for-secrets.sh) detects JWT patterns in staged files before commit
PowerShell equivalent script for Windows developers
npm run security:scan and npm run security:scan:staged available
Secret handling policy documented at docs/security/secret_handling_policy.md
Policy mandates live login/session for acceptance testing, not persisted token files
Policy explicitly prohibits broad git add . without reviewing staged diff
QA/acceptance scripts should read tokens exclusively from environment variables, not from committed files
